narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Yes. Parallel and equal opposite sides always make a rectangle.
<bookmark mark='lean'/>Look at one diamond of the gate. Its opposite sides are parallel and equal.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>But two of its corners are sharp and two are wide, and none is square.
removed_beats.on_screen: the hint card leaves; Chintu's bubble: parallel and equal opposite sides always make a rectangle; one leaning diamond from the gate is lifted out; the bubble is struck in the warning colour

narration: <bookmark mark='test'/>To test a definition, look for a shape that has the property but is not the shape.
<bookmark mark='sq'/>Then check every corner of your drawing with a set square.
removed_beats.on_screen: the stage clears except the gate and the answer card; two check lines: look for a shape that has the property but fails the definition; check every corner with a set square

old_misconception.wrong_answer: parallel and equal opposite sides always make a rectangle
old_misconception.wrong_move: Chintu says parallel and equal opposite sides always make a rectangle. A slanted shape has both, yet none of its corners is a right angle, so the bubble is struck.
